task_goal: Land the spacecraft on the landing pad at (0,0) with zero velocity, upright orientation, and minimal fuel consumption, as fast as possible.
reward_function_interface: def compute_reward(state, m_power, s_power, terminated) -> (float, dict)
state_space: 8-dimensional vector: [x, y, vx, vy, angle, angular_velocity, leg1_contact, leg2_contact] normalized to approximately [-1,1].
action_space: Discrete: 0 (do nothing), 1 (fire left orientation engine), 2 (fire main engine), 3 (fire right orientation engine).
success_like_ending: Both legs ground contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Episode termination without crash or out-of-bounds.
behavior_trajectory_prior: Phase 1: Descent and stabilization - reduce vertical speed, center horizontally over pad, maintain upright orientation.
Phase 2: Final approach - fine-tune position and velocity to land softly on pad with both legs contacting simultaneously.
Phase 3: Landing - zero velocity, upright, both legs on ground, terminate with success.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely at safe altitude without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing with high vertical speed (crash) but receiving small negative reward if not penalized enough.
Using orientation engines excessively causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing outside pad but with low speed (no crash, but not success).
